# BH Garage Door Metro Detroit

> Licensed & insured garage door installation and repair company serving all of Metro Detroit, Michigan. Broken springs, openers, cables & rollers, panel replacement, new door installation, commercial overhead doors.

## About

BH Garage Door Metro Detroit is a licensed and insured garage door company headquartered in Detroit, Michigan. We dispatch trained technicians across every city in Metro Detroit for same-day garage door repair and scheduled installations. Typical on-site arrival is 15–30 minutes for emergency calls.

- Business name: BH Garage Door Metro Detroit
- License: Licensed & Insured
- Phone: (313) 236-4558
- Email: info@bhgaragedoormetrodetroit.com
- Hours: Sun–Thu 24 hours · Fri until 6 PM · Sat closed
- Service area: All of Metro Detroit, MI (Detroit, Warren, Sterling Heights, Troy, Dearborn, Livonia, Royal Oak, Southfield, Farmington Hills, Pontiac, Canton, Westland, and every surrounding city in Wayne, Oakland, and Macomb counties).

## Services

- 24-hour emergency garage door repair (stuck doors, off-track doors, snapped springs)
- Garage door repair (tracks, hinges, sections, alignment, noisy doors)
- New garage door installation (steel, insulated, carriage-house, modern glass)
- Torsion & extension spring replacement
- Garage door opener installation & repair (belt, chain, wall-mount jackshaft)
- Cable, roller & track repair
- Panel & section replacement
- Commercial overhead doors (rolling steel, sectional, loading dock)
- Garage door tune-up & preventive maintenance
- Smart openers & keypads (Wi-Fi openers, smartphone control, keypad entry)
